comment:
* Class that contains a set of tables mapping byte ids to long values.
 *
 * This class is used to store the ProcessStats data.  This data happens to be
 * a set of very sparse tables, that is mostly append or overwrite, with infrequent
 * resets of the data.
 *
 * Data is stored as a list of large long[] arrays containing the actual values.  There are a
 * set of Table objects that each contain a small array mapping the byte IDs to a position
 * in the larger arrays.
 *
 * The data itself is either a single long value or a range of long values which are always
 * stored continguously in one of the long arrays. When the caller allocates a slot with
 * getOrAddKey, an int key is returned.  That key can be re-retreived with getKey without
 * allocating the value.  The data can then be set or retrieved with that key.

variables.name: ID_SHIFT
variables.comment: Where the "type"/"state" part of the data appears in an offset integer.

variables.name: ARRAY_SHIFT
variables.comment: Where the "which array" part of the data appears in an offset integer.

variables.name: INDEX_SHIFT
variables.comment: Where the "index into array" part of the data appears in an offset integer.

methods.comment: * Write the data arrays to the parcel.

methods.name: public void readFromParcel(Parcel in)
methods.comment: * Read the data arrays from the parcel.

methods.name: private static void writeCompactedLongArray(Parcel out, long[] array, int num)
methods.comment:
* Write the long array to the parcel in a compacted form.  Does not allow negative
     * values in the array.

methods.name: private static void readCompactedLongArray(Parcel in, long[] array, int num)
methods.comment: * Read the compacted array into the long[].

methods.name: public static byte getIdFromKey(int key)
methods.comment: * Extract the id from a key.

methods.name: public static int getArrayFromKey(int key)
methods.comment:
* Gets the index of the array in the list of arrays.
     *
     * Not to be confused with getIndexFromKey.

methods.name: public static int getIndexFromKey(int key)
methods.comment:
* Gets the index of a value in a long[].
     *
     * Not to be confused with getArrayFromKey.
